analysis.background: Puumala virus (PUUV) is the main cause of nephropathia epidemica, a zoonotic disease with renal complications and no approved vaccine, representing a public‑health threat.
analysis.methods: An immunoinformatics pipeline was used to design an mRNA multi‑epitope vaccine (PV‑GNProtecta) from conserved glycoprotein and nucleoprotein regions, including epitope prediction, antigenicity/allergenicity/toxicity screening, population‑coverage analysis, physicochemical assessment, structural modeling, TLR4 docking, MM‑GBSA, 100 ns molecular dynamics, codon optimization for E. coli, and immune‑simulation.
analysis.results: Highly antigenic, non‑allergenic, non‑toxic T‑ and B‑cell epitopes were assembled; the construct showed broad HLA coverage, favorable stability, solubility and antigenicity; 95.5% of residues fell in favored Ramachandran regions with an ERRAT score of 91.4; docking and MM‑GBSA predicted strong interaction with TLR4, confirmed by stable dynamics in MD; codon usage matched E. coli expression; immune simulation indicated potential IgG, IFN‑γ and IL‑2 responses.
analysis.contribution: The study provides a computationally validated mRNA vaccine candidate and a workflow that may accelerate PUUV vaccine development and broader immunoinformatics applications.
analysis.limitations: All findings are based on in‑silico analyses; experimental validation of expression, translational efficiency, stability and immunogenicity is required; evidence is limited to the abstract.

analysis.summary_en: Background: PUUV causes nephropathia epidemica, a zoonotic disease with renal complications and no approved vaccine. Methods: An immunoinformatics pipeline designed an mRNA multi‑epitope vaccine (PV‑GNProtecta) using conserved viral proteins, performing epitope selection, antigenicity checks, population coverage, physicochemical and structural analyses, TLR4 docking, MD simulation, codon optimization, and immune simulation. Results: The construct contains highly antigenic, non‑allergenic, non‑toxic epitopes, shows broad HLA coverage, favorable stability (95.5% Ramachandran favored, ERRAT 91.4), strong predicted TLR4 interaction, stable 100 ns MD behavior, E. coli‑compatible codons, and simulated IgG, IFN‑γ, IL‑2 responses. Contribution: Offers a computationally validated mRNA vaccine candidate and a pipeline for PUUV vaccine research. Limitations: Findings are purely computational; experimental validation is needed; only abstract data are available.

papers.title_zh: 设计并进行计算评估 PV‐GNProtecta:一种针对 普马拉病毒 的 mRNA 多表位疫苗候选,采用免疫信息学和结构分析

analysis_zh.background: 普马拉病毒(PUUV)是肾病流行性(nephropathia epidemica)的主要致病因子,这是一种伴有肾脏并发症的动物源性疾病,且尚无获批疫苗,构成公共卫生威胁。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用免疫信息学流程设计了一个mRNA多表位疫苗(PV-GNProtecta),来源于保守的糖蛋白和核蛋白区域,包括表位预测、抗原性/过敏性/毒性筛选、人口覆盖分析、理化评估、结构建模、TLR4对接、MM-GBSA、100 ns分子动力学、E. coli的密码子优化以及免疫模拟。
analysis_zh.results: 组装了高度抗原性、非过敏性、非毒性的T细胞和B细胞表位;该构建体显示出广泛的HLA覆盖率、良好的稳定性、溶解性和抗原性;95.5%的残基位于优选的Ramachandran区,ERRAT得分为91.4;对接和MM-GBSA预测与TLR4有强烈相互作用,分子动力学稳定性进一步证实;密码子使用与E. coli表达匹配;免疫模拟提示可能产生IgG、IFN-γ和IL-2反应。
analysis_zh.contribution: 本研究提供了一个计算验证的mRNA疫苗候选者和一套工作流程,可加速PUUV疫苗开发及更广泛的免疫信息学应用。
analysis_zh.limitations: 所有发现均基于计算分析;需要实验验证表达、翻译效率、稳定性和免疫原性;证据仅限于摘要。

papers.title: Human febrile illness associated with Yanggou tick virus: Clinical characteristics and epidemiological links to rodents.
papers.abstract: Objectives We identified Yanggou tick virus (YGTV), a segmented flavivirus previously unrecognized as a human pathogen, in a patient presenting with fever and headache. This study aims to characterize the epidemiology and clinical manifestations of YGTV infection in patients with fever of unknown origin (FUO). Methods We conducted a surveillance study at the First Hospital of Jilin University (2020-2025) involving 1011 patients with FUO. Concurrently, ticks and rodents in the vicinity of the patients' residences and workplaces were collected for viral detection. YGTV infection was confirmed via PCR assays. Positive samples were used for viral isolation, genome amplification, and phylogenetic characterization. An Apodemus agrarius challenge model was established to evaluate viral persistence and shedding. Results Of the 30 confirmed cases of YGTV infection, 10 were co-diagnosed with hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS). The patients showed no clear seasonality or geographic bias. Notably, rodent contact (43.3%) was a more frequent risk factor than tick bites (6.7%). While clinical presentations were non-specific, nearly 50% of the patients presented with gastrointestinal and neurological symptoms. YGTV was isolated from patients, ticks, and A. agrarius (the latter often co-infected with Hantaan virus). Animal models confirmed persistent splenic infection and viral shedding via oral and fecal routes. Conclusion Our findings establish YGTV as an underdiagnosed cause of human febrile illness, underscoring the transmission risks posed by tick vectors and rodent reservoirs. These results highlight the urgent need for enhanced clinical surveillance and diagnostic screening among patients presenting with FUO, particularly in regions where the virus is endemic.

source_records.abstract: Objectives We identified Yanggou tick virus (YGTV), a segmented flavivirus previously unrecognized as a human pathogen, in a patient presenting with fever and headache. This study aims to characterize the epidemiology and clinical manifestations of YGTV infection in patients with fever of unknown origin (FUO). Methods We conducted a surveillance study at the First Hospital of Jilin University (2020-2025) involving 1011 patients with FUO. Concurrently, ticks and rodents in the vicinity of the patients' residences and workplaces were collected for viral detection. YGTV infection was confirmed via PCR assays. Positive samples were used for viral isolation, genome amplification, and phylogenetic characterization. An Apodemus agrarius challenge model was established to evaluate viral persistence and shedding. Results Of the 30 confirmed cases of YGTV infection, 10 were co-diagnosed with hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS). The patients showed no clear seasonality or geographic bias. These results highlight the urgent need for enhanced clinical surveillance and diagnostic screening among patients presenting with FUO, particularly in regions where the virus is endemic.

papers.title: Hantavirus in Dentistry: Occupational Exposure Considerations and a Proposed Tiered Infection Prevention and Control Framework-A Narrative Review.
papers.abstract: Objective The aim of this study is to synthesize evidence on hantavirus transmission and occupational exposure pathways relevant to dentistry, and to propose an evidence-informed tiered infection prevention and control (IPC) framework that distinguishes established from theoretical risk. Material and methods The initial narrative search covered database inception through May 15, 2026 in MEDLINE/PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, Scopus, Google Scholar, and WHO/CDC/ECDC/OSHA sources, followed by a targeted PubMed/MEDLINE and public-health guidance update through August 18, 2026. Approximately 1450 records were identified. After duplicate removal, 1070 records were subjected to title/abstract screening, 215 full-text records were assessed for eligibility, and 45 sources were included in the final synthesis, comprising 34 peer-reviewed publications and 11 gray-literature or public-health guidance sources. Results Environmental exposure to infected-rodent contamination is the established occupational pathway. Limited person-to-person transmission is documented for the Andes virus (ANDV), but no dental transmission has been reported. ANDV RNA and culture-based infectivity have been demonstrated in some oral/respiratory fluids; however, dental-aerosol transmission has not been shown. Dental-specific occupational risk therefore remains unquantified. Conclusions No dental transmission has been documented, and patient-related risk remains uncertain. Standard precautions and rodent control are foundational; suspected or confirmed ANDV warrants transmission-based precautions and airborne precautions for aerosol-generating procedures according to current guidance. The proposed dental tiers are evidence-informed, author-derived, and unvalidated.

papers.title_zh: 汉坦病毒 在牙科:职业暴露考虑及提出的分层感染预防与控制框架——叙述性综述。

analysis_zh.background: 开展本综述旨在综合关于 汉坦病毒 传播途径在牙科实践中的证据,并制定分层感染预防框架。
analysis_zh.main_directions: 概述环境啮齿动物暴露为主要职业途径,指出 安第斯病毒 的人际传播有限,并提出牙科专用的感染预防控制分层,将标准预防与基于传播的防护区分开来。
analysis_zh.current_state: 已有研究确认环境污染是主要风险,尚未有牙科传播的记录,仅观察到极少数 安第斯病毒 气溶胶传播案例。
analysis_zh.gaps: 牙科特定暴露风险的规模尚未量化,所提出的分层框架亦未得到验证。
analysis_zh.future_research: 需要开展分层感染预防控制模型的验证研究,并对牙科环境中 汉坦病毒 暴露风险进行定量评估。

papers.summary_zh: 背景：开展本综述旨在综合关于 汉坦病毒 传播途径在牙科实践中的证据,并制定分层感染预防框架。 主要方向：概述环境啮齿动物暴露为主要职业途径,指出 安第斯病毒 的人际传播有限,并提出牙科专用的感染预防控制分层,将标准预防与基于传播的防护区分开来。 研究现状：已有研究确认环境污染是主要风险,尚未有牙科传播的记录,仅观察到极少数 安第斯病毒 气溶胶传播案例。 不足：牙科特定暴露风险的规模尚未量化,所提出的分层框架亦未得到验证。 后续研究：需要开展分层感染预防控制模型的验证研究,并对牙科环境中 汉坦病毒 暴露风险进行定量评估。

papers.title: DNA and mRNA Vaccines Against Hantaviruses: Antigen Design, Delivery Strategies and Translational Progress.
papers.abstract: Hantaviruses are members of the Hantaviridae family, which can cause hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) and hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome (HCPS). At present, no specific antiviral treatment is available for hantavirus infection, while licensed hantavirus vaccines are restricted to a limited number of countries in Asia. This review summarizes recent advances in hantavirus deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) and messenger RNA (mRNA) vaccines, focusing on antigen design, delivery systems, immunogenicity, safety and translational development. Peer-reviewed studies published primarily within the past 10 years were evaluated together with available hantavirus vaccine trials registered in ClinicalTrials.gov, with emphasis on Hantaan virus (HTNV), Puumala virus (PUUV) and Andes virus (ANDV). DNA vaccine candidates have demonstrated immunogenicity in preclinical and early clinical studies, with an acceptable safety profile. mRNA vaccines represent a newer approach with promising preclinical evidence of humoral and cellular immune responses. However, they have not yet been evaluated clinically. Studies have also reported the potential for varying degrees of cross-protection between hantavirus species, although protection remains limited by antigenic diversity. Overall, current evidence supports further development of nucleic acid-based hantavirus vaccines, particularly multivalent strategies, with emphasis on standardized evaluation and clinical efficacy.

analysis.summary_en: Background: Hantaviruses cause HFRS and HCPS and lack specific antivirals and widely available vaccines. Main directions: The review covers DNA and mRNA vaccine advances, focusing on antigen design, delivery, immunogenicity, safety, and translational work, especially for HTNV, PUUV, and ANDV. Current state: DNA vaccines show immunogenicity and safety in preclinical/early clinical studies; mRNA vaccines elicit strong immune responses preclinically but have no clinical data yet. Gaps: Antigenic diversity limits cross‑protection and mRNA candidates lack clinical evaluation, requiring standardized efficacy assessment. Future research: Prioritize multivalent nucleic‑acid vaccines, conduct rigorous clinical trials, and establish standardized evaluation frameworks to determine clinical efficacy.

papers.title_zh: DNA和mRNA疫苗针对汉坦病毒:抗原设计、递送策略与转化进展

analysis_zh.background: 汉坦病毒es 引起肾综合征出血热和汉坦病毒心肺综合征,且目前没有特异性抗病毒药物,获批疫苗仅限于少数亚洲国家。
analysis_zh.main_directions: 本综述总结了近期DNA和mRNA疫苗的进展,重点强调抗原设计、递送系统、免疫原性、安全性以及转化进展,聚焦于HTNV、PUUV和ANDV。
analysis_zh.current_state: DNA疫苗候选物已在临床前和早期临床研究中显示出免疫原性和可接受的安全性,而mRNA疫苗在临床前模型中表现出有前景的体液和细胞免疫应答,但尚未进行临床评估。
analysis_zh.gaps: 由于抗原多样性,汉坦病毒种之间的交叉保护有限,且mRNA疫苗缺乏临床数据,表明需要标准化的效力评估。
analysis_zh.future_research: 进一步研发应以多价核酸疫苗为目标,开展严格的临床试验,并采用标准化的评估框架以确立临床疗效。

papers.title: Epidemiology and Economic Burden of Puumala Virus Infection in Styria, Austria, 2003 to 2024
papers.abstract: Background Hantavirus infections cause hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome and impose a potential burden on healthcare systems. However, comprehensive economic data remain scarce. We quantified the inpatient economic burden of hospitalized patients with Puumala virus (PUUV) infections in Styria, Austria's primary endemic region, to identify hospitalization costs and early admission predictors of costs. Methods This retrospective cost-of-illness study analyzed 1049 serologically confirmed PUUV hospitalizations across 20 public hospitals in Styria, Austria between September 2003 and March 2024. Costs were estimated using the Austrian performance-oriented hospital financing (Leistungsorientierte Krankenanstaltenfinanzierung) diagnosis-related group system, standardized to 2024-equivalent Euros using consumer price index deflation. Admission predictors of cost were assessed using multivariable γ-generalized linear modeling with multiple imputations. Temporal trends in length of stay were analyzed using weighted segmented linear regression. Results Cumulative inpatient cost was ∼€10.3 million (mean per-case: €9788) for the entire study period of 21 years. Three epidemic years (2012, 2019, and 2021) accounted for 53.6% of cases and over €5.2 million in expenditure, with peak annual costs reaching €1.93 million (0.274% of total Styrian inpatient expenditure) in 2012. Prolonged activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT; cost-ratio 1.024 per second, 95% CI 1.019-1.030) and older age (CR 1.004 per year, 95% CI 1.001-1.008) were independent admission-level predictors of higher cost. Median hospital length of stay declined by ∼50% over the study period. Conclusions PUUV hospitalizations impose a sharply episodic but recurrent economic burden on regional healthcare systems. Admission aPTT and age independently predicted cost, but clinical outcomes were not modeled and these variables do not constitute a triage tool. Epidemic preparedness strategies are warranted.

analysis.background: Hantavirus infections cause hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome and impose a potential burden on healthcare systems; comprehensive economic data on Puumala virus (PUUV) are scarce.
analysis.methods: A retrospective cost‑of‑illness study analyzed 1,049 serologically confirmed PUUV hospitalizations across 20 public hospitals in Styria, Austria from September 2003 to March 2024; costs were estimated via the Austrian DRG system and standardized to 2024 €; admission cost predictors were assessed with multivariable γ‑GLM and multiple imputation; temporal trends in length of stay were examined using weighted segmented linear regression.
analysis.results: Cumulative inpatient cost was ≈€10.3 million (mean €9,788 per case) over 21 years; three epidemic years (2012, 2019, 2021) accounted for 53.6% of cases and >€5.2 million, with a peak annual cost of €1.93 million (0.274% of Styrian inpatient expenditure) in 2012; prolonged aPTT (cost‑ratio 1.024 per s, 95% CI 1.019‑1.030) and older age (CR 1.004 per yr, 95% CI 1.001‑1.008) independently predicted higher cost; median length of stay fell ≈50% over the period.
analysis.contribution: The study provides the first comprehensive quantification of the economic burden of PUUV hospitalizations in Austria and identifies admission‑level cost drivers, informing healthcare budgeting and epidemic preparedness strategies.
analysis.limitations: Only abstract data are available, limiting detail on methodology and potential biases; clinical outcomes were not modeled, and the identified predictors do not constitute a validated triage tool.

analysis.summary_en: Background: Hantavirus infections cause hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome and impose a potential burden on healthcare systems; economic data on PUUV are scarce. Methods: Retrospective cost‑of‑illness study of 1,049 PUUV hospitalizations in Styria, Austria (2003‑2024) using Austrian DRG costing, γ‑GLM for cost predictors, and segmented regression for length‑of‑stay trends. Results: Total inpatient cost ≈€10.3 M (mean €9,788 per case); three epidemic years contributed 53.6% of cases and >€5.2 M, peak €1.93 M in 2012; prolonged aPTT and older age independently increased cost; median stay fell ~50%. Contribution: First comprehensive quantification of PUUV hospitalization costs in Austria, highlighting cost drivers for budgeting and preparedness. Limitations: Abstract‑only data, no clinical outcomes modeled, predictors not a triage tool.

papers.title_zh: 2003至2024年奥地利施蒂利亚地区普马拉病毒感染的流行病学与经济负担

analysis_zh.background: 汉坦病毒感染导致肾综合征出血热,并对医疗系统构成潜在负担;关于普马拉病毒(PUUV)的综合经济数据稀缺。
analysis_zh.methods: 一项回顾性疾病成本研究分析了2003年9月至2024年3月期间奥地利施蒂利亚20家公立医院中1,049例血清学确诊的PUUV住院病例;费用通过奥地利DRG系统估算并标准化为2024年欧元;入院费用预测因素采用多变量γ-广义线性模型并结合多重插补进行评估;住院时长的时间趋势使用加权分段线性回归进行检验。
analysis_zh.contribution: 本研究首次对奥地利PUUV住院的经济负担进行全面量化,并识别了入院层面的费用驱动因素,为医疗预算编制和流行病防备策略提供参考。
analysis_zh.limitations: 仅有摘要数据可得,限制了方法学细节和潜在偏倚的阐述;未对临床结局进行建模,且所识别的预测因素并非经验证的分诊工具。
